Use of Hydrocortisone Butyrate Lotion for this indication is supported by evidence from an adequate and well-controlled trial in 284 pediatric patients 3 months to 18 years of age with mild to moderate atopic dermatitis. The safety and effectiveness of Hydrocortisone Butyrate Lotion have not been established in pediatric patients younger than 3 months of age.
